value.rationale: The exact family determines the sharp boundary of a current universality theorem: p=infinity has universal second-adjoint attainment, all finite p admit full-support failures, and the norm perturbations approach the original isometrically. The support trichotomy simultaneously classifies ordinary, bidual-only and no attainment for all probability weights, a structurally motivated and natural classification beyond generic renorming existence.
